description: This PHP source file defines the UrlSigner class within the Aws\CloudFront namespace. The class provides functionality to generate signed URLs for Amazon CloudFront resources, supporting different URL schemes such as http, https, and rtmp. It includes methods for URL signing, creating resource identifiers based on URL schemes, and handling query parameters for securing access to cloud resources.

classes.name: UrlSigner
classes.description: A class for generating signed URLs for Amazon CloudFront resources, supporting multiple URL schemes and custom policies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UrlSigner with a key pair ID and private key used for signing URLs.

methods.name: getSignedUrl
methods.description: Creates and returns a signed URL with authentication parameters, supporting optional expiration and custom policies.

methods.name: createRtmpUrl
methods.description: Constructs a relative URL for RTMP scheme URLs, including query parameters if present.

methods.name: createResource
methods.description: Generates a resource identifier based on the URL scheme, handling http, https, and rtmp protocols.
